'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Gladiator found with her daughter, '''Licinia''' by [[Asphodel Barrens]] Resonance Beacon at day time. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;After {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}

----
;After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:;'''Licinia:''' Pa! I heard the Blessed Maiden's voice!
:;'''Drusilla''' Why not tell him how you stood with everyone against the Dark Tide?
:'''Licinia:''' Pa always loved hearing me chatter about little things. He wouldn't mind this either.
:'''Drusilla''' Go on, then. We can leave a bit later.
:'''Licinia:''' Thanks, Ma! Now… where should I start?
:'''Licinia:''' Oh, I know! Let's begin with the day when the Blightcloud over the Plateaus started to stir…
:'''Drusilla''' Keep talking. I'll borrow a jug and water these flowers.
{{Dialogue End}}
